params.body:
An invitation refused by the app tonight came back as `Vera answered 404: <nil>`. The run was refused, the record was written, and neither said why: the adapter printed `res["error"]` with `%v`, and Vera answers some refusals without a JSON error at all — a 404 for a review that does not exist has none.

`said(status, res)` now turns the answer into a sentence: the app's own words where it gives them, "no such review" on a 404, "the gateway's token does not open this" on a 401 or 403, and "without saying why" when the app truly said nothing, which is at least honest about the silence.

A refusal that cannot say why is the one failure this project keeps coming back to: the record exists precisely so a reader can tell what happened without asking the person who ran it.
params.title: Een weigering zegt wat er scheelt
